definitions.explanation: So surprising, extreme, or extraordinary that it is difficult to accept as true.

examples.japanese: {信|しん}じ{難|がた}い⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
{信|しん}じ{難|がた}いこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無傷|むきず}→無傷：13458_mukizu⟧だった。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ほど⟦{短期間|たんきかん}→短期間：17178_tankikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{信|しん}じ{難|がた}い⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧だ。
examples.english: Succeeding in such a short time is an unbelievable result.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ (to believe) + ⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ (difficult to ~). The suffix ～⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ attaches to verb stems to express difficulty or impossibility.

USAGE:
The ～⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ pattern is productive in Japanese: ⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧し⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ (hard to understand), ⟦{許|ゆる}し{難|がた}い→許し難い：29288_yurushigatai⟧ (hard to forgive). {信|しん}じ{難|がた}い is one of the most commonly used combinations. It has a slightly more formal and literary tone than ⟦{信|しん}じられない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信|しん}じ{難|がた}い⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ — an unbelievable story
- {信|しん}じ{難|がた}い⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ — an incredible result
- {信|しん}じ{難|がた}いこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — incredibly; unbelievably

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{信|しん}じられない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ — unbelievable; more colloquial and emotional
- ⟦{考|かんが}え→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ — hard to imagine; difficult to conceive
- ⟦{耐|た}え{難|がた}い→耐え難い：19680_taegatai⟧ — unbearable; difficult to endure
